name: level-1 (H170M)
about: The self-test rocket. Row 288 of sft_v5 (level-1.ork): one stage, one AeroTech H170M in a 38 mm mount, 66 mm Kraft phenolic body, three plywood fins, one 0.91 m parachute, no stored simulation. Flown on every check_setup() and before a design that hung or crashed the helper is retried. Expected numbers measured 2026-11-19 with the RocketSim helper on OpenRocket 24.12 / JDK 17.0.21 (Windows 11); the team's OrBatch helper gives the same numbers to the last digit. The tolerance is a machine check, not a score number: other machines can move time to apogee by one 0.05 s step (0.43%) and flight time by a few tenths of a percent, while a wrong jar, motor list or helper moves these numbers by far more.
